files.jail.local:
[DEFAULT]
banaction = iptables-allports
maxretry = 2
banaction_allports = nftables[type=allports]
[pure-ftpd]
enabled = true
backend = auto
logpath = /dev/null
          /nonexistent/y
maxretry = 1
findtime = 10m
action = iptables[name=a]
           iptables-multiport[name=b, port=ssh]
filter = %(__name__)s[mode=extra]
ignoreip = example.com
port = http,https
usedns = no
[exim-spam]
enabled = true
backend = systemd
action = nftables-multiport[blocktype=DROP, port="80,443"]
ignoreip = ::1 10.0.0.0/8, 192.168.1.1
